# aidial_translator (Resource)

Manages a translator in DIAL Core (`PUT /v1/translators/{bucket}/{path}`): a service that converts requests from the `in` interface type to the `out` interface type.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "aidial_translator" "example" {
  bucket   = "platform"
  path     = "openai-to-claude"
  base_url = "https://translator.example.invalid"

  # Interface types: openaiChatCompletions, openaiEmbeddings,
  # openaiResponses, anthropicMessages.
  in  = "openaiChatCompletions"
  out = "anthropicMessages"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `base_url` (String) Base URL of the translator service.
- `bucket` (String) Target DIAL bucket. Must be "platform".
- `in` (String) Incoming interface type. One of `openaiChatCompletions`, `openaiEmbeddings`, `openaiResponses`, `anthropicMessages`.
- `out` (String) Outgoing interface type. One of `openaiChatCompletions`, `openaiEmbeddings`, `openaiResponses`, `anthropicMessages`.
- `path` (String) Translator path inside the bucket. DIAL Core accepts letters, digits and `._%:@[]()-`, so it cannot contain `/`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Resource identifier in the form <bucket>/<path>.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = aidial_translator.example
  id = "platform/openai-to-claude"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by <bucket>/<path>. DIAL Core accepts only the "platform" bucket for translators.
terraform import aidial_translator.example platform/openai-to-claude
```
